author: Pool Shark
text_post: Hey everyone i started my pua journey you could say a while ago then stopped. I want to start again can anyone tell me where too start. Ive already read the game and have a lot material. I just wanna know is there a specific place to start.

author: mintbase
text_post: Hey Pool Shark, I suggest getting together with someone who is at about your level and have some fun just opening sets and seeing how far you can get in each one. Push yourself to remain in the set for as long as possible. To start a night off I usually build up my state by opening anyone and everyone; Even the bus driver on the way into town!! If you haven't already got the mystery method book I suggest you get hold of a copy and 'small chunk' the ideas in there. Best of luck. Mint
